p7.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/final-cac-question-responses-9-19-25-redacted-c-1.pdf
p7.excerpt: The Community Impact Fund, as proposed in the Application, is valued at $163 million over the 30-year length of the license. Our commitments will be binding under the gaming license, ensuring accountability and delivery.

p8.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/final-cac-question-responses-9-19-25-redacted-c-1.pdf
p8.excerpt: The Fund is structured for annual disbursements, guaranteeing stable support for nonprofits, parks, and cultural institutions.

p9.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/final-cac-question-responses-9-19-25-redacted-c-1.pdf
p9.excerpt: There is another $25 million dedicated to three neighborhood projects: East Elmhurst health clinic, Corona/Jackson Heights senior/youth center, and Flushing addiction services. There are also individual philanthropic commitments totaling approximately $2 million

p10.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2026/03/12.01.25.gflbselectiondocument1.pdf
p10.excerpt: The funding of these additional years should be resolved in the manner previously indicated in footnote 5 on Page 8.

decisions.label: ENTAILMENT
decisions.reason: Both passages state that another $150 million was proposed for a community impact fund and that the applicant committed to this $150 million over a 30-year license term.

decisions.label: NEUTRAL
decisions.reason: The excerpt says funding of additional years should be resolved as previously indicated, but it does not state that the Board proposed alternatives for commitments extending beyond the awarded term.

decisions.label: NEUTRAL
decisions.reason: The passages show a $163 million fund and separately mention about $25 million for neighborhood projects and about $2 million in philanthropic commitments, but they do not establish a CAC schedule placing a $150 million operating tranche inside a $163.2 million phased package.
